name: DecomposedLWE
title: Decomposed LWE (Abram-Malavolta-Roy, CRYPTO 2025) as a concrete assumption
description: AdvancedEncryption.WE.Assumptions.DecomposedLWE.decision, Definition 4.1 of ePrint 2025/339: (A_i, B_j, s^T A_i B_j + s^T G delta_ij + e_ij^T)_{i,j in [t]} vs (A_i, B_j, u_ij) with A_i, s, u uniform mod q, B_j <- D_sigma^{m x n} and e_ij <- D_sigma~^n over the integers, n = k ceil(log q), G = I_k (x) (1, 2, ..., 2^{ceil(log q)-1}). Claimed strength: plain LWE's (dimension k, t^2 n samples, error sigma~) only in the regime of Theorem 4.2 (q prime, m >= 2k ceil(log q), sigma^2 >= k ceil(log q) ceil(log m), sigma~ >= 2^128 sigma); a conjecture. Equivalent to succinct LWE (ePrint 2026/2443).
